messages:
oliver (PM): Heads-up — ACMEHealth asked for an "optimize advisor" mini-pilot that combines batching/caching presets, quantization recommendations, and eval-triggered regression alerts. They want a concierge onboarding then opt-in to self-serve. Timeline: customer wants pilot in ~6 weeks. Can we scope?
anya (PM): +1. Need to clarify must-haves vs nice-to-haves. Proposal: MVP = 1) heuristic batching/caching recommendations, 2) offline quantization advice (no automatic quantize in MVP), 3) eval-alerts that trigger email/console alerts for quality drops. No live auto-mitigation yet.
kai (Eng): Sounds doable if we limit models to gpt-ish open models (Llama3/Redwood-verified). Big unknown: infra for eval-triggered alerts (eval runner + signal ingestion).
ravi (ML): For eval alerts we need: baseline eval suite (customer prompts), rolling evaluation job, and thresholds. Recommend we require customers to provide 500 prompt pairs for pilot. Alerts defined as >X point drop in task-level metric or drift in token-level perplexity.
marisol (Solutions): ACMEHealth will provide example prompts and is fine with a concierge approach. They want an SLA on false positives — lower spam. They prefer weekly digest + high-severity immediate alerts.
sophie (CS): Also flag: they care about latency regressions post-quantization. We should include guidance for downstream p99 delta tolerances.
kai (Eng): Implementation sketch: 1) Recommendation engine = offline analyzer that ingests traffic snapshot + perf traces -> outputs recommended batch_size, enable_prefix_cache boolean, and quantization profile suggestions. 2) Eval runner = scheduled job (k8s CronJob) that runs evals against pinned model/version and emits metrics to telemetry. 3) Alerting layer subscribes to eval metrics and hits Console/email.
oliver (PM): Nice. Can we define launch criteria? Proposal: MUST: automated recommendations for batch/cache, quant profile doc with shortlist, eval-alerts integrated to Console, pilot onboarding doc. SHOULD: per-route simulation of expected cost delta.
anya (PM): Success metrics (pilot acceptance): - Customer onboarded within 2 sprints (<=4w) - Recommendations reduce token cost by >=10% on their dev workload (simulated) OR reduce inferred calls / tokens via caching suggestions - Alert precision >=70% on seeded regressions
ravi (ML): For seeded regressions we can create synthetic quality drops (temperature, prompt truncation) to measure alert recall/precision. We'll need hooks into their eval datasets.
kai (Eng): Engineering constraints: ETA for MVP if we do a 2-week focused sprint + 2-week polish: 4w dev + 1w ops + 1w pilot = 6w. Need 1 backend eng + 1 infra + 1 ML eng + 0.5 PM. Dependencies: eval infra (job runner), Console alerting APIs, model perf profiler.
marisol (Solutions): Customer asks about dedicated capacity vs hosted behavior — pilot should support both but we can limit to hosted for MVP. ACMEHealth is ok with hosted for now.
anya (PM): Risk list: - Noisy alerts -> customer churn. - Quant suggestions might underperform on certain long-context prompts. - Data privacy for eval datasets (we should support obfuscation).
oliver (PM): Mitigations: conservative default thresholds, human-in-the-loop for alert triage during concierge, and opt-out for model telemetry.
release-bot: deploy scheduled for optimize-advisor/mvp on staging at 2024-11-21T09:00:00Z
kai (Eng): Quick spec fragment for alert threshold config (proposal):
```
alert_config: 
  metric: "task_accuracy"
  baseline_window: "30d"
  trigger: "delta <= -0.03 AND p_value < 0.01"
  severity: "high|medium|low"
  notify: ["console","email"]
```
marisol (Solutions): ACMEHealth will want a human review step before high-severity emails during concierge. Add that to runbook.
sophie (CS): Can we add a lightweight ROI calc for recommendations? e.g., estimated monthly token savings and latency impact. Even a rough number helps sell.
anya (PM): Agree. Ownering: kai -> eng implementation; ravi -> eval/seeded-regressions; marisol -> customer onboarding + runbook; oliver -> success metrics + pilot contract.
oliver (PM): Next steps: kai + ravi to produce a one-pager tech spec by EOD Fri. marisol to confirm dataset availability with ACMEHealth. I'll draft pilot success SLA. If anyone can't take their owner, speak now.
kai (Eng): I'll start the spec. tagging @ravi for seeded regressions plan.
ravi (ML): On it.
marisol (Solutions): I'll ping them today.
anya (PM): Quick poll: emoji react to accept scope as-is. :thumbsup: = accept, :thumbsdown: = push-back.
oliver (PM): Thanks — will collate reactions and turn into JIRA epic next week.
